parsed.degree_signal: BS, MS, or PhD in Electrical, Mechanical, Computer, or Controls Engineering, or a related technical discipline
parsed.notes:
Who You Are supplies candidate requirements; no optional qualification heading appears. What We Need describes responsibilities, and What You Will Learn describes future learning, so neither supplies additional skills.
The distributed control systems mapping is flagged because a specialized control-system requirement may not match the taxonomy's general Distributed Systems entry. The software architecture mapping is flagged because the architecture requirement spans hardware and mechanical systems as well as software.
Liquid-cooling equipment knowledge and datacenter infrastructure knowledge are treated as excluded domain knowledge; control methods, protocols, automation, and subsystem integration are treated as technical practices.
Telemetry is covered by observability rather than assigned a separate invented taxonomy ID.
The alternatives in 'distributed control systems, industrial automation, datacenter infrastructure, or thermal management systems' leave only one mapped taxonomy skill, so no alternative_group is emitted.
The explicit Senior Staff / Principal title determines seniority despite the statements welcoming candidates at various levels.
